paper_title: Further Exploiting c-Closure for FPT Algorithms and Kernels for Domination Problems
classifications: Theory of computation → Fixed parameter tractability
statement: We resolved the parameterized complexity of three domination problems – Perfect Code, CDS and PDS– on c-closed graphs. We believe that our results, along with that of Koana et al. [39], make a convincing case for pursuing the closure of a graph as a significant structural parameter. We also believe that the arguments in this paper can be adapted to solve similar problems on c-closed graphs. In particular, our strategy for Perfect Code may be applicable to the Even Dominating Set (resp. Odd Dominating Set) problems, where the goal is to check if a graph G has a dominating set D of size at most k such that D dominates every vertex of G an even (resp. odd) number of times. While we showed that PDS is W[1]-hard even on 2-closed graphs, the status of Partial Vertex Cover on c-closed graphs still remains open. It would be interesting to see if any our results extend to weakly γ-closed graphs (see [26] and [38]) as well.
